name: 86 Chaos 16.0.97 System Admin Runtime Interop Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.97 System Admin Runtime Interop Fix
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.97 System Admin Runtime Interop Fix
notes: System Administrator runtime imports now safely resolve CommonJS helper modules in the browser bundle.
The section error boundary now keeps a fallback report ID even if runtime-report helper interop fails.
System Administrator live-data safety helpers now fall back safely instead of crashing the console when module interop changes.
Firebase-sensitive configuration, Schedule Builder, employee deletion, shift deletion, and push-repair behavior were not changed.
